Chou Soujuu Mecha MG.name: Chosoju Mecha MG
Chou Soujuu Mecha MG.summary:
Chou Soujuu Mecha MG is a 2006 Nintendo DS mecha action game developed by Sandlot, the studio behind the Earth Defense Force series, and published by Nintendo. It combines the developer's aptitude for larger-than-life spectacle with one of the most innovative and fun uses of the touch screen in the DS library: in addition to standard movement with the D-Pad, each of the game's 100+ playable mecha has its own unique "cockpit" controlled with the touch screen.

The game was mentioned in the Super Smash Bros. series, under the officially romanized title of Chosoju Mecha MG.

Contact.name: Contact
Contact.summary: Contact is a role-playing video game developed by Grasshopper Manufacture for the Nintendo DS handheld game console. It was published by Marvelous Entertainment in Japan on March 30, 2006, by Atlus in North America on October 19, 2006, and by Rising Star Games in Australasia and Europe on January 25, 2007 and February 6, 2007 respectively.

I Did It Mum! 2 - Girl.name: I did it Mum! 2
I Did It Mum! 2 - Girl.summary: A collection of educational minigames for the youngest of gamers. Comes in both girl and boy versions.

Jillian Michaels Fitness Ultimatum 2010.name: Jillian Michaels' Fitness Ultimatum 2010
Jillian Michaels Fitness Ultimatum 2010.summary: Jillian Michaels' workout game for 2010 was released on the Wii and DS in October 2009.

Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo - Manhattan.name: Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Manhattan Requiem & Kiss of Murder
Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo - Manhattan.summary: A compilation of two of the J.B. Harold games for DS.

Koe de Asobou - HeartCatch PreCure!.name: Koe de Asobou! HeartCatch PreCure!
Koe de Asobou - HeartCatch PreCure!.summary: A game in which you can watch video clips from the Heartcatch PreCure! anime, record your own voices for each of the characters, add sound effects, and watch/listen to the results.

Petz Rescue - Wildlife Vet.name: Petz Rescue: Wildlife Vet
Petz Rescue - Wildlife Vet.summary: Play as a young vet, who has just opened their first animal clinic. Take care of your neighbors’ domesticated pets, as well as the local exotic baby animals. Diagnose, cure, observe and heal the animals to gain your clients’ confidence and respect. Uncover the mystery behind the animals’ illnesses. Investigate to find out if the local factory could be polluting the rivers and thus be causing the animals’ diseases. Face real challenges on the journey to becoming a great veterinarian, and possibly join one of the world’s most prestigious NGOs.

Saikin Koi Shiteru.name: Saikin Koi Shiteru?
Saikin Koi Shiteru.summary: Saikin Koi Shiteru? is an otome game, developed by Microvision and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Scurge - Hive.name: Scurge: Hive
Scurge - Hive.summary: Bounty hunter Jenosa Arma went against her instincts and took the job anyway. Now she's trapped in a giant research lab in space, fending off a parasite called Scurge. She must get to the root of the infection before it takes over everything--including her own body.

Zubo.name: Zubo
Zubo.summary: Zubo is a 3D rhythm action game set in the vibrant and melodic universe of Zubalon. Players enter Zubalon to help the zany inhabitants, the Zubos, defeat a malicious mastermind and his army of dastardly Zombos.
